name: Wren
about: HeroByte's narrator: a tabletop Game Master's voice. Redesigned 2026-10-07 from the 'Female narrator' prompt, following ElevenLabs' Voice Design guide (language and dialect first, age, quality, persona, emotion, then timbre and pacing; no FX words; 'accent' only for the regional dialect).

variants.voice_description: Native English, General American. Female, mid-30s to early 40s. Studio quality. Persona: seasoned tabletop game master and storyteller. Emotion: warm, wry, quietly dramatic. Rich, warm mid-pitched timbre with smooth, close-mic presence. Relaxed, conversational pacing for clear explanations, slowing and dropping lower for dramatic moments, with a subtle cheeky lift in her intonation, as if guiding a chaotic party and enjoying every minute of it.

text: [warm, storytelling] Pull up a chair. The candles are lit, the dice are warm, and somewhere beyond that door, something is waiting for you. [wry] No, I won't tell you what. That would spoil the fun. [clear, friendly] When you're ready, roll a d twenty and tell me what you do. Take your time. I'll wait... [quietly amused] and please, this time, nobody lick the glowing mushroom.
